sample.question:
At each crossing, W means the vertical warp strand is on top and H means the horizontal weft is on top. The ideal first row is visible; each following ideal row rotates the previous pattern right by 1 position(s). Coordinates are zero-based (row,column).
Ignoring damaged crossings, what should the next row after the displayed board be, from column 0 to 5?
A. H W H W H H
B. H H W H W H
C. H H H W H W
D. W H H H W H
E. H W H H H W
F. W H W H H H
sample.analysis: The base pattern is H H H W H W. Row 6 applies a total right shift of 0, giving H H H W H W. The answer is C.
options: A. H W H W H H
B. H H W H W H
C. H H H W H W
D. W H H H W H
E. H W H H H W
F. W H W H H H
